name: Hoian by Mevui
description: a Vietnamese restaurant chain with a location in Canggu, Bali, called Hoi An by Mevui. It offers authentic Vietnamese cuisine like pho (noodle soup) and banh mi (sandwiches), using fresh, local ingredients. The Canggu restaurant is a popular spot, especially with international tourists, and provides a dining experience that includes rice paddies and sunset views
